Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Blaine Modern Sleeper Sofa Bed, 78"W, Beige
Colors: Beige
Materials: Polyester
Add mid-century elegance to your living room with this beige sofa bed. The solid-wood frame and polyester upholstery make this sofa bed both sturdy and cozy, and the removable/reversible cushions ensure durability and comfort. Overall: 78"W x 37.8"D x 35"H; seat height: 19.3"H; seat depth: 21.7"D; seat back height: 25.6"H; arm height: 24.4"H; leg height: 4.9"H Solid-wood frame and legs with 100% polyester upholstery The tight, removable back cushions and fixed seat cushions ensure durability and comfort. Simple assembly in less than 15 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This item is made to order just for you
